holdout_era_authorization: Owner explicitly authorized all available dates for this fixed configuration. This records holdout-era exposure #1; the later interval is previously studied, nonblind historical evidence.

bb_episode.selection: latest qualifying contiguous bb_compressed run wholly in the confirmation-preceding 12 valid BB bars; a left-truncated run exposes its actual known start/length for description but the label uses only the in-window portion

independent_labels.bb_episode_directional_order9_run3: within selected BB episode, any 3 consecutive bars whose cross-group six-MA order is >=9/12 in V8 side; >=12/12 run is descriptive only
independent_labels.bb_ma_tight_overlap_run3: within selected BB episode, any 3 consecutive bb_compressed bars also at/below causal preceding-256 valid-bar P20 of six-MA width/close
independent_labels.opposed_completed_htf: last completed same-venue/symbol HTF bar as of signal confirmation: adverse cross-group order >=9/12 and close on adverse side of fast-pair center

htf.daily: UTC day made only from all six valid, no-gap four-hour bars; close-only SMA/EMA 20/60/120 is calculated per contiguous complete-day segment
htf.asof: last HTF close_time <= V8 signal_confirmation_time; missing source/history is unknown, never false

matching.control: nearest confirmation time from label complement, deterministic trade_id tiebreak, no reuse within label and exact block
matching.inference: asset-by-month block sign-flip, fixed 10000 draws plus-one two-sided correction; Holm across three labels, exploratory nonblind

execution_contract: Unchanged frozen V8 same-entry outcome, signal close to next observed open, original 3ATR admission, stops/exits/costs. No execution replay or account curve.
